description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files in a project repository, specifically checking for module specifier violations related to openclaw/plugin-sdk subpaths. It reads configuration files such as package.json and plugin-sdk-entrypoints.json, resolves source roots, and inspects source files for import specifiers to ensure they are properly exported.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads and returns a set of plugin subpaths exported by the project's package.json.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads and returns a set of plugin subpaths listed as entrypoints in plugin-sdk-entrypoints.json, excluding 'index'.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts the subpath from a module specifier if it starts with 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/'.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting violation entries based on file, line, kind, specifier, and subpath.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Main logic that collects missing or unexported plugin SDK subpath imports across the project's TypeScript files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes the violation collection and outputs the result, indicating success or failure.
